metric: p95 latency of the decrypt + LIKE scan, AES-256-GCM over pgcrypto AES-CBC
gate: the worst gated-cell ratio (gcm_decrypt / pgcrypto decrypt_iv) must be at most max_ratio; a cell whose session count is not in gated_sessions is recorded but not gated
runner_cpu: to be recorded from three CI runs
note: A ratio, never milliseconds. `samples` is scans per query per cell, split across the two queries and the sessions. The 32-session cells are recorded, not gated: at 10k rows a whole scan is a few milliseconds, so under 32 concurrent sessions the p95 is scheduling tail rather than crypto and the ratio converges to 1.0 (local runs of the 10k x 32 cell ran 0.77-1.03). Refresh recorded_runs and recorded_ratio from three load.yml runs and set max_ratio to the worst observed gated ratio across them times 1.2, rounded up to one decimal, never above 1.0 — the design's requirement that GCM not be slower than the pgcrypto scan it replaces.
